messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 3612345678 — GPU prefill memory surge detected in cluster us-west1-gpu-pool. Affected service: runtime-prefill. Multiple containers restarted. First seen 2025-09-12T23:34:38Z.

jamie_oncall: I'm on it, paged and joining triage. Can someone paste the most recent container logs? I'll start live mitigation.

alex_sre: tail from container abc123 (killed at 2025-09-12T23:36:05Z)
```
[2025-09-12T23:36:01Z] runtime: prefill start seq_len=24576 user_id=xxxxx session=yyy
[2025-09-12T23:36:04Z] CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY: couldn't allocate 12.3GiB
[2025-09-12T23:36:05Z] Process killed: OOM-killer invoked, container aborted
```

priya_ml: Looks like large-context prefill (~24.6k tokens) pushed KV + allocation peak. Immediate mitigation: throttle long-context prefill and route >16k tokens to coldmodel fallback. Quick config suggestion to apply at edge router: \n```
route_policy:\n  max_prefill_tokens: 16000
  fallback_model: model-cold-v2
  kvcache_eviction: aggressive
```

morgan_infra: I'll cordon+drain node45 to stop restart churn and free GPU memory. Running: 
```
kubectl cordon node45 && kubectl drain node45 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

jamie_oncall: Live mitigation checklist (applied or in progress):
- throttle prefill requests >16k tokens (edge router rule)
- increase kvcache trim frequency to 30s
- enable coldmodel fallback for affected model route
- cordon node45 and bounce runtime there

sre-ops: Customer impact (telemetry): ~12 tenants saw failed generation requests, 6 tenants had streaming disconnects. Top affected account: acme-corp — ~18% error rate on chat endpoint between 23:34-23:42 UTC. Customer Ops notified, not yet SEV but elevated.

alex_sre: Hotfix PR created to enforce per-request prefill cap and fail-fast on oversized prefill. Rolling as 10% canary now. PR: https://git.redwood/PR/4321

priya_ml: Also recommend temporarily disabling long-prefix caching in hotpool to avoid KV residency growth while we stabilize.

jamie_oncall: Handoff plan: I'll stay for ~20m, then hand to @alex_sre for overnight watch. Current status: node45 drained, hotpatch canary at 10%, observed error rate dropping from ~12% -> ~4% in monitored routes. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Update at 2025-09-12T23:51:10Z: canary rollout increased 10% -> 50%. Monitoring OOM events and prefill_vram_percent. Alerts configured: prefill_vram_percent > 78% for 3m.

alex_sre: I'll pick this up for the night. Next actions: finish canary -> full rollout if stable for 30m, publish postmortem template, notify Sales for acme-corp checkin. Assigning follow-ups to @alex_sre and @priya_ml.

morgan_infra: Collected traces/metrics and archived logs: /var/logs/incident-3612345678.tar.gz. Saved GPU profiles and dmesg.

jamie_oncall: Thanks team — moving to watch mode. Leaving handoff notes in the incident doc and Slack thread. :coffee:
